q1.a: We build business websites, web applications, mobile apps and custom software systems. We also handle UI/UX design, API integration and ongoing maintenance.

q2.a: We are based in Sulaymaniyah, in the Kurdistan Region of Iraq, and work with clients across Iraq and remotely.

q3.q: How much does a website or app cost?
q3.a: Every project is scoped individually based on features, timeline and integrations. Contact us with your requirements and we will send a clear estimate.

q4.q: How long does a project take?
q4.a: A focused website usually takes a few weeks; larger platforms and custom systems are planned in phases. We agree on a timeline before work starts.
